enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Insightful Command: Passive: +6 Insight bonus on Charisma based skill checks. Command armor and command shields make their owners very noticeable, imposing a -6 penalty on Hide checks.
Repair Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming repair healing by +43 (Enhancement bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Repair Lore +18: Passive: Your Repair and Rust spells gain a 18% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Reconstruction +122: Passive: +122 Equipment bonus to Repair and Rust Spell Power.
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
